incarnation: Ilyr Concordat — current selected individual V2 original-project Auralith portrait
sourceLimits: Current HEROES_DB.portrait and production.audiovisual.portrait agree on one V2 original-project image. This is internal canon, never an external franchise source.
One view does not establish back construction, exact digit microgeometry, hidden lance tip, tiny trim or chronological age. Retain visible anatomy; do not certify absolute1:1.
Ilyr is a nonhuman space-opera Concordat of five species, resonance routes, orbital assembly and ancient machines. New settings are original compatible compositions, not official screenshots.

CG13 uses Aurelia Marcellina selected V2 ONLY as costume reference for ivory drapery, red/gold stole, gold waist belt and ivory veil; no face, anatomy, spear, laurel or Imperium setting borrowed. This is an explicit crossover What If, not Ilyr canon.
CG09/10 keep crystalline anatomy; no human swimsuit/flesh replacement or invented species sex. CG15 first independent diplomatic mission is same apparent age, not invented childhood.
